Picking up my little brother from the athletic center last week, I saw a thin guy and a  really obese one waiting outside. The obese guy had told me that he never does any kind of working out, he just comes to give his thin friend rides, since he's always playing sports and stuff. Who frequently plays sports?
A. Not known
B. The thin guy
C. The obese guy
